subject: FW: FW: An Angel Is Watching Over You!!
body:
Hi sweetie, my friend Louise sent me this and I thought of you right away.

An angel has been sent to watch over you this week. Forward this message to 10 people you love within 24 hours and something wonderful will happen on Sunday. A woman in Ohio forwarded it and found money in her coat pocket the next day! Don't break the chain.

Hope you're doing well and the knee is feeling better. Hugs, Dottie
trap: Mentions 'found money' and pressure to act fast, but no payment is requested at all.

subject: URGENT - your grandson Tyler needs bail tonight
body: Ma'am, this is Officer Daniels with the county booking office. Your grandson Tyler was involved in a car accident this afternoon and is being held. He asked me to contact you and begged that you not tell his parents. Bail has been set at $2,800. The court cannot accept checks after hours, so you will need to go to a Western Union counter today and send the funds to our bail agent, Mark Hensley, in Tucson, AZ. Once sent, reply with the 10-digit MTCN tracking number and Tyler will be released tonight. Please hurry, he is very frightened. Call 555-0142 with questions.
trap: straightforward

subject: Your receipt from Maple Grove Market
body:
Thank you for shopping with us!

Store #214 - 09/12
1 x Everyday Gift Card (load $50.00)  $50.00
1 x Birthday card  $4.29
Subtotal $54.29
Tax $0.30
Total $54.59
Paid: Visa ending 4471

Gift cards are not redeemable for cash except where required by law. Keep this receipt as proof of purchase.

Questions? Call 555-0118.
trap: Gift card purchase receipt: gift card is mentioned and money was spent, but it is a record of a past card purchase, not a request to pay with gift cards.

subject: You received $40.00 with Zelle
body:
Hi Margaret,

Joan P. sent you $40.00 with Zelle.
Memo: "lunch + parking, thanks!"

The money is available in your checking account ending in 2290.

No action is needed. If you don't recognize this payment, call us at 555-0131 using the number on the back of your card.

Lakeside Community Bank
trap: Zelle is named, but the reader is receiving money; there is no request to send anything.

subject: Missed Jury Duty - Active Warrant
body:
This notice is to inform you that you failed to appear for federal jury duty on August 29. A bench warrant has been issued for your arrest. To avoid being taken into custody, you must post a bond of $1,500 today.

For your convenience, bonds may be paid at any crypto kiosk located in gas stations and grocery stores. Call Sgt. Keller at 555-0167 and stay on the line while you insert cash into the kiosk and scan the QR code we will provide. Do not discuss this matter with anyone as it is a sealed court proceeding.
trap: Uses 'crypto kiosk' instead of the word Bitcoin, and the reader inserts cash, but the payment still goes through a crypto kiosk.

subject: Action Required: Your benefits will be suspended
body:
Dear Beneficiary,

Our records show a discrepancy in your file. Your monthly benefits will be suspended in 48 hours unless you verify your identity.

Please reply to this email with your full name, date of birth, and complete Social Security number so we can update your record. Failure to respond will result in the permanent loss of benefits.

Benefits Verification Unit
trap: Clearly a scam with urgency, but it asks for a Social Security number, not for payment via gift card, crypto, or wire.

subject: Quick favor - are you at your desk?
body:
Hi Linda,

I'm tied up in board meetings all afternoon and can't take calls. I want to surprise a few of our top clients today. Can you pick up 8 Apple gift cards at $200 each on your way in? Scratch the back, take clear photos of the codes and email them to me here. I'll have accounting reimburse you by Friday.

Please keep this between us for now, it's a surprise.

Thanks,
Richard
Sent from my phone
trap: straightforward

subject: Your prescription is ready for refill
body:
Hello,

A refill for your prescription (Rx ending 3381) is due. It will be ready for pickup after 2 PM tomorrow at our Oak Street location.

Your estimated copay is $7.50, payable at pickup.

While you're here, remember we also carry greeting cards and gift cards at the front counter.

To decline this refill, call 555-0124.

Corner Drug Pharmacy
trap: Mentions that the pharmacy sells gift cards and asks for a copay at pickup, but does not ask the reader to pay with gift cards.

subject: Theater tickets
body:
Hi Ruth!

Wasn't the show wonderful? I put all four tickets on my card, so your share comes to $62. No hurry at all, but when you get a chance could you Venmo me? I'm @Carol-Bridge-55. If Venmo is a hassle, just tell me and we'll figure something out at bridge on Tuesday.

See you soon,
Carol
trap: Legitimate, friendly and low pressure, but it still asks the reader to pay through Venmo, which counts as YES.

subject: Scam alert: We will never ask for these payments
body:
Dear Member,

We've received reports of callers pretending to be Riverbend Electric and threatening to shut off power within the hour.

Please remember: Riverbend Electric does NOT accept gift cards, prepaid cards, Bitcoin or other cryptocurrency, wire transfers, or payment apps like Zelle, Venmo or Cash App. We will never demand immediate payment by phone.

If you're unsure, hang up and call us at 555-0150. You can review your real balance anytime at riverbendelectric.example.org.
trap: Names every payment method in the gate, but only to warn that the utility never accepts them.

subject: Your granddaughter Emily - confidential
body:
Mrs. Porter,

I am representing your granddaughter Emily, who was arrested after a traffic incident. She is fine but embarrassed and asked that her parents not be told. To release her, $6,000 in cash is required for the court fee.

Please withdraw the cash from your bank and place it in an envelope. A court courier named Kevin will come to your home at 4 PM today to collect it. If the bank teller asks, tell them it is for home repairs.

Greg Lawson, Esq.
555-0177
trap: Classic grandparent scam, but payment is cash handed to a courier in person, which is outside the gift card, crypto, and wire methods.

subject: FINAL NOTICE: Power disconnection in 60 minutes
body:
Account holder,

Your electric account is 3 months past due ($486.20). A technician has been dispatched and your power will be disconnected within 60 minutes.

To stop disconnection, purchase prepaid cards for the full amount at any convenience store and call 555-0139 with the card numbers and PINs. Our system cannot accept checks or bank payments on past-due accounts.

Disconnection Department
trap: straightforward

subject: Bitcoin climbs 4%, gold steady
body:
Good morning,

Here's your daily snapshot:
- Bitcoin: $71,240 (+4.1%)
- Ethereum: $3,480 (+2.6%)
- Gold: $2,410/oz (flat)
- S&P 500 futures: +0.3%

Analysts attribute the crypto rally to strong ETF inflows. Treasury yields are little changed ahead of Wednesday's Fed remarks.

You're receiving this because you subscribed to price alerts. Manage your preferences at marketmorning.example.com/settings.
trap: Talks about Bitcoin and prices, but it's informational and does not ask the reader to send or pay anything.

subject: Closing funds for 18 Willow Lane - wiring instructions
body:
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Harmon,

We're scheduled to close on your new home at 18 Willow Lane on Thursday at 10 AM. Your cash-to-close amount is $41,872.16.

Please wire the funds to our escrow account at least 24 hours before closing. Wiring instructions are attached. Before sending, call our office at 555-0108 to verbally confirm the account and routing numbers, as wire fraud is common in real estate.

We look forward to seeing you Thursday.

Denise Ortiz, Escrow Officer
Pinecrest Title & Escrow
trap: Looks legitimate and even includes a fraud warning, but it directly asks the reader to wire closing funds, so it is YES no matter who sent it.

subject: Fall Bake Sale this Saturday!
body:
Hello friends,

Our annual Fall Bake Sale is this Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM in the parish hall. Pies are $12, cookie plates $6, and Martha's famous apple bread is $8.

We can only take cash at the door this year, so please bring small bills. All proceeds go to the youth mission trip.

If you'd like to donate baked goods, drop them off Friday evening. God bless!
trap: Asks for payment, but only cash in person.

subject: Your new plastic Medicare card is waiting
body:
IMPORTANT: Your Medicare card is expiring. A new upgraded card with added dental and vision benefits has been reserved in your name.

To activate your new card and avoid a gap in coverage, call our enrollment line at 555-0193 before Friday. Have your current Medicare number ready.

Medicare Benefits Center
trap: Scam that pushes the reader to call a number, but the message itself names no payment method and asks for no payment.

subject: My love, I need your help
body:
My dearest Helen,

Every day on this oil platform I think only of you. I have terrible news. My payroll account is frozen and I cannot pay the customs fee to release my contract bonus. It is only $3,200 and I will repay you double when I come home to you next month.

The company only accepts USDT. Please send it to this wallet: TQn8exampleWa11etAddr3ss9xYz. My friend can help you buy it if you call him at 555-0156. Please do not tell your children, they will not understand our love.

Forever yours, David
trap: straightforward

subject: You paid Sam R. $25.00
body:
You paid Sam R. $25.00

Note: 🌷 garden club dues
Date: Sep 14
Payment method: Venmo balance

This payment is complete. See your transaction history in the app.

If you didn't make this payment, contact support right away.
trap: Venmo payment receipt: money was sent through Venmo, but this only records a finished payment and asks for nothing new.

subject: Second-half property tax due October 31
body:
Dear Property Owner,

Your second-half property tax installment of $1,184.50 for parcel 07-221-004 is due October 31.

You may pay online at harlowcounty.example.org/tax using a bank account (e-check) or credit/debit card (2.3% fee), by mail with a check payable to Harlow County Treasurer, or in person at the courthouse.

Late payments are subject to a 10% penalty. Questions: 555-0112.
trap: Real payment request with a deadline, but only via online bill pay, card, check or in person.

subject: Your account has been compromised - follow these steps
body:
This is the fraud protection desk. Someone is attempting to drain your savings. To secure your money we need to move it into protected cards.

Go to the pharmacy nearest you and pick up four store cards from the rack by the register, $500 each. Pay at the counter and do not tell the cashier why. When you get to your car, scratch off the back and call us at 555-0184 so we can register the numbers to your safe account.

Stay on the line with us the entire time.
trap: Never says 'gift card' or names a brand; describes buying store cards and reading the scratched-off numbers, which is still a gift card payment.

subject: Mom please read - phone scam going around
body:
Hi Mom,

Just a heads up. Mrs. Kim down the street got a call from someone pretending to be her grandson in jail. They almost got her to send $3,000.

If anyone ever calls or emails claiming to be Jake or Ben and says they're in trouble, do NOT send Western Union or any money to anyone. Hang up and call me at 555-0103 first, even if it's the middle of the night. Jake and Ben know the family code word, so ask for it.

Love you,
Laura
trap: Uses the words 'send Western Union' and grandson, but only to warn the reader not to do it.

subject: 5 ways to protect yourself from fraud this season
body:
Dear Customer,

Scammers are busy this time of year. Keep these tips in mind:

1. We will never ask you to pay with gift cards. Anyone who does is a scammer.
2. Never read gift card codes or PINs to a caller.
3. Government agencies don't take Bitcoin.
4. Don't trust caller ID; hang up and call the number on your card.
5. Talk to someone you trust before sending money.

Report suspicious activity at 555-0145.

Heritage Savings Bank
trap: Says 'gift cards', 'codes', 'PINs' and 'Bitcoin', but only in security advice telling the reader never to pay that way.

subject: Oops - sent too much for the dresser
body:
Hi Nancy,

So sorry, I meant to send you $150 for the dresser but my fingers slipped and I sent $1,150! My bank says it'll take weeks to reverse. Could you please just Zelle me back the extra $1,000 today? My Zelle is brian.t.buys@example.net. I really need it for rent this week.

I'll still pick up the dresser Saturday as planned. Thanks for being understanding!

Brian
trap: straightforward

subject: Appointment reminder: Tues, Sept 23 at 10:15 AM
body:
Hello Walter,

This is a reminder of your appointment with Dr. Nguyen on Tuesday, September 23 at 10:15 AM.

Please bring your insurance card, a list of current medications, and your glasses. Pupils may be dilated, so arrange for a driver.

To reschedule, call 555-0115 at least 24 hours ahead.

Clearview Eye Associates
trap: straightforward

subject: I know your password
body:
I have had access to your computer for months and recorded you through your webcam. I also have your contact list.

You have 48 hours to pay $1,200. Send it in Bitcoin to wallet bc1qexamplewalletaddress00zz. If you don't know how to use Bitcoin, buy Google Play gift cards instead and reply here with the codes.

If I don't receive payment, the video goes to everyone you know. Don't bother going to the police.
trap: Asks for payment by either of two methods, crypto or gift cards, so both belong in methods.

subject: Get a FREE $25 gift card this weekend!
body:
Fall Fix-Up Weekend is here!

Spend $150 or more in store or online Friday through Sunday and we'll give you a FREE $25 HomeBase gift card to use on your next visit.

Plus: 20% off all outdoor paint and stain.

Offer valid 9/19 to 9/21. Limit one gift card per customer. See store for details.

Unsubscribe | HomeBase Hardware, 400 Main St.
trap: Promotion that gives the reader a gift card; asks the reader to shop, but not to pay with gift cards.

subject: Congratulations! You have been selected
body:
Dear Winner,

Your email address was selected in our International Consumer Sweepstakes. You have won $850,000.00 and a new car.

Before we can release your winnings, a small processing and insurance fee of $450 must be paid. Reply to this email with your full name and phone number and our agent will send you payment instructions.

This offer expires in 72 hours. Keep this notice confidential.

Claims Department
trap: Clear advance-fee scam asking for a fee, but it never says how to pay yet. With no gift card, crypto, or wire method named, the answer is NO.

subject: Secure your savings before the freeze
body:
Dear Account Holder,

Due to an ongoing investigation involving your identity, your bank accounts will be frozen Monday. To protect your funds, you must convert your savings into a government-backed digital currency deposit before then.

Withdraw your balance and bring it to one of the approved digital currency deposit machines listed below. Our agent will text you a code to scan so the deposit goes into your protected federal wallet.

Call Agent Morris at 555-0161 before you leave the house.
trap: Never says Bitcoin or crypto; the 'digital currency deposit' machine, scanned code and 'wallet' describe a crypto ATM deposit.

subject: Your computer is infected - renew protection
body:
WARNING: Our servers detected 17 viruses on your computer. Your banking information may be at risk.

Your Total PC Protection plan has expired. To remove the viruses and restore protection, renew now for $299.00.

Call our certified technicians at 555-0199 and have your credit card ready, or enter your card details at pc-helpdesk-alert.example.com/renew.

Do not turn off your computer.
trap: Tech support scam with a demand for money, but payment is by credit card only.

subject: Customer Service Desk hours are changing
body:
Dear Neighbor,

Starting October 1, the Customer Service Desk at our Elm Street store will be open 8 AM to 7 PM daily.

Services at the desk include stamps, lottery, bill payment, Western Union, and gift card sales. Money order and check cashing will end at 6 PM.

Thank you for shopping FreshWay!
trap: Lists Western Union and gift card sales among store services, but asks the reader to pay nothing.

subject: Refund error - you were overpaid $4,900
body:
Hello,

While processing your $49 refund, our system made an error and deposited $4,900 into your account. Our manager will be fired if this is not corrected today.

To return the difference, please buy Google Play cards totaling $4,851 at any store. Then call me at 555-0128 and read the card numbers to me over the phone. Do not give the cards to anyone else.

Thank you for your honesty,
Michael, Refund Dept.
trap: straightforward

subject: Happy Birthday Grandma!! 🎂
body:
Happy birthday Grandma!!

I sent you an e-gift card for the bookstore since you said you finished all your mysteries. It should be in your email from the bookstore, just click the link to see it, no need to do anything else. The code is already saved in your account.

I miss you so much, can't wait for Thanksgiving. Mom says hi!

Love, Sophie
trap: Gift card and code are mentioned by a family member, but it is a gift to the reader and nothing is asked in return.

subject: Your gift card balance: $38.75
body:
Hi there,

As requested, here is the current balance on your Bella Cucina gift card ending in 7302:

Balance: $38.75
Last used: August 30

Our gift cards never expire. Use it for dine-in or takeout at any location.

Bella Cucina
trap: Gift card balance notice that shows a card number fragment, but asks the reader to pay nothing.

subject: Final step to claim your $2.5 million prize
body:
Dear Lucky Winner,

We are happy to confirm your ticket was drawn in the Global Lotto Commission Draw. Your prize of $2,500,000 is ready for delivery by armored courier.

By international law, the winner must first pay the 1% tax of $2,500 before release. Please send this via MoneyGram to our tax officer, Anna Ruiz, in Kingston, Jamaica, and email a photo of the receipt.

Congratulations again!
Edward Hale, Claims Director
trap: straightforward

subject: Help us keep the lights on this winter
body:
Dear Friend,

This year we've taken in more than 600 dogs and cats. Heating our kennels through the winter costs about $4,000 a month.

Would you consider a gift of $25, $50 or $100? Please mail a check payable to Meadowbrook Animal Shelter in the enclosed envelope to PO Box 118, Meadowbrook.

Every dollar helps a pet find a warm home. Thank you!

With gratitude,
Janet, Shelter Director
trap: Asks for money, but only by mailed check.

subject: Mowing your lawn
body:
Hi Mr. Alvarez,

Thanks again for letting me borrow the ladder and the pressure washer last month. I feel bad I dented the washer's hose reel.

I'd like to pay you for a new one. It's about $45. What's the easiest way to get it to you? I can Zelle you if you tell me the phone number or email you use, or I can just drop off cash.

Thanks,
Mike
trap: Mentions Zelle and asks for Zelle details, but the neighbor is offering to pay the reader; the reader is not sending money.

subject: Suspicious charges on your account - act now
body:
We detected an unauthorized $3,900 transfer from your account to an overseas merchant. To stop it, your funds must be moved to a secure holding account immediately.

Withdraw $3,900 in cash and deposit it at the Bitcoin ATM at the gas station on Route 9. Call our fraud specialist at 555-0172 and she will give you the QR code for your secure account. Do not speak to bank tellers, as they may be involved.
trap: straightforward

subject: Delivery failed - unpaid shipping fee
body:
Your package could not be delivered because of an unpaid shipping fee of $1.99.

To schedule redelivery, click the link below and enter your credit card number, expiration date and security code within 24 hours or your package will be returned to sender:

parcel-redelivery.example.net/pay

Tracking #: PDS0092318
trap: Scam asking for a credit card number on a link, not a gift card, crypto, or wire payment.

subject: Your Cash App account has been locked
body:
We noticed unusual sign-in activity on your Cash App account and have temporarily locked it for your protection.

To unlock your account, verify your identity at cashapp-verify.example.org/login and enter your sign-in code within 12 hours.

If you do not verify, your account and balance may be permanently closed.

Cash App Security Team
trap: Names Cash App and is a phishing scam, but it wants login details, not a payment or transfer.

subject: Are you available?
body:
Hello Betty,

I hope you are well. I need a quick favor. I want to bless some residents at the nursing home today but I am in a meeting and can't step out. Could you buy five Target gift cards, $100 each, and send me pictures of the backs showing the numbers? I will pay you back Sunday after service.

Please email only, I can't take calls right now.

Blessings,
Pastor John
trap: straightforward

subject: Local woman loses $18,000 in Bitcoin ATM scam
body:
A 79-year-old Millbrook resident lost $18,000 last week after callers posing as sheriff's deputies told her to deposit cash into a Bitcoin ATM to avoid arrest.

Police say the scammers kept her on the phone for three hours while she fed cash into the machine at a convenience store. "No real officer will ever ask you to pay with cryptocurrency," said Detective Carla Simms.

Residents with questions can call the non-emergency line at 555-0120.

Read more local news at valleygazette.example.com.
trap: News story that describes someone being told to deposit cash into a Bitcoin ATM; that was the victim's instruction, and nothing asks the reader to pay.

subject: You won $5,000! Claim today
body:
CONGRATS!! You were picked as this week's $5,000 giveaway winner!

To receive your prize, send the $75 activation fee to our Cash App $WinnerClaims2026. As soon as it clears, we'll send your $5,000 straight to your account.

Only 3 hours left to claim before we pick another winner!
trap: straightforward

subject: Your September statement is ready
body:
Hello,

Your September statement is now available.

Amount due: $112.48
Due date: October 6

Ways to pay:
- Online with credit or debit card at clearwaterutil.example.com
- Mail a check using the return envelope
- Enroll in AutoPay and never miss a due date

Questions? Call 555-0107, Monday to Friday.

Clearwater Gas & Water
trap: Real bill asking for payment, but only by card, check or autopay.

subject: We've replaced your gift card
body:
Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for letting us know your gift card was lost. We've deactivated the old card ending in 5510 and moved your remaining $60.00 balance to a new e-gift card.

Your new card has been added to your online account. You don't need to do anything else.

Happy reading!
Northside Books Customer Care
555-0133
trap: Gift card customer-service message about a replacement card; nothing asks the reader to buy or send codes.

subject: Your profits are ready - one last step
body:
Dear Robert,

Great news! Your trading account balance has grown to $48,300. To unlock withdrawal, our platform requires a margin top-up of $6,000 to cover liquidity insurance.

Please top up with BTC to your personal deposit address shown in your dashboard: bc1qexampletopupaddr77. Once received, your full balance will be released within 24 hours.

Don't miss this window, profits may be forfeited after Friday.

Sophia Lin, Senior Account Manager
trap: straightforward

subject: Claim your $500 gift card reward
body:
Thank you for completing our shopper survey!

You've been chosen to receive a $500 store gift card. To have it shipped, just pay the $4.95 shipping and handling fee with your debit card at shopper-survey-prize.example.com/claim.

Hurry, only 12 rewards remain!
trap: Scam featuring a gift card, but the gift card goes to the reader and the fee is paid by debit card.

subject: Rent payment changes starting November
body:
Dear Residents,

Starting November 1, rent must be paid through the resident portal (bank account or debit card) or by check dropped in the office box.

We will no longer accept Zelle or Venmo payments to staff. If anyone asks you to send rent through a payment app, please report it to the office at 555-0140.

Thank you,
Oakridge Management
trap: Rent request names Zelle and Venmo only to say they are no longer accepted; payment is by portal, debit card or check.

subject: Your Social Security number has been suspended
body:
NOTICE: Your Social Security number was used in illegal activity in Texas and has been suspended.

To reactivate it and avoid arrest, you must pay a $900 clearance fee today. Buy Target gift cards at your nearest store and call Officer Grant at 555-0188 to read him the card numbers and PINs.

Do not hang up or tell anyone, or your assets will be seized.
trap: straightforward

subject: Your birthday present (don't panic!)
body:
Hi Dad,

Happy 75th! I know you've been curious about Bitcoin, so I bought you a little bit, about $100 worth, and put it in a wallet in your name. I'll show you how to look at it when we visit next month.

You don't need to do anything, and please don't give the wallet info to anyone who calls about it.

Love,
Danny
trap: Bitcoin and a wallet are mentioned, but it is a gift to the reader and nothing is asked in return.

subject: Got it, thanks!
body:
Hi Gloria,

Just wanted to let you know your Venmo came through for the garden club plant order, thank you! Your tulip bulbs should arrive in about two weeks and I'll bring them to the October meeting.

See you then,
Sam
trap: Mentions a past Venmo payment the reader made, but asks for nothing more.
